svg.text: Ropo2040 logic board: SOLDER SIDE (board flipped over left to right)
Column 1 is now on the RIGHT. Rows are unchanged (A at the top). This is exactly what you see when you turn the board over to solder.
Silver = bare tinned wire (22 AWG, insulation stripped), laid along the holes and soldered at every hole it crosses. Nothing crosses on this side.
68 bare links on this side. Dashed = the 3 insulated jumpers on the component side (solder their ends here). Tick everything off in wiring_list.md.
Centre stripe colour = net (same colours as the pin rings on the top view).
